sloka: काले धर्मार्थकामान् यः सम्मन्त्र्य सचिवैः सह ।निषेवेतात्मवान् लोके न स व्यसनमाप्नुयात् ।। ६.६३.१२ ।।
transliteration: kāle dharmārthakāmān yaḥ sammantrya sacivaiḥ saha ।niṣevetātmavān loke na sa vyasanamāpnuyāt ।। 6.63.12 ।।

translations.english: "You are the foremost of the Rakshasas! After discussing with ministers, a king either by gifting or conciliation or dissension or resorting to all of them at the appropriate time takes resort to pursue virtue, wealth, or sensual pleasures at the right time, never meets with sorrow."
translations.hindi: दूसरे राक्षसा को तो बरदान का बल है, किन्तु यह महाबली कुम्भकर्ण तो| स्वभाव ही से तेजस्त्री है
